name: After § 5
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section X – European External Action Service
part_text: 5 a. Regrets the 62 520 euro spent at a Toyota dealer in Gibraltar and the 53 707 euro spent for the “bamboo supplier” in Jamaica (22 Trafalgar road) at the EU delegation; regrets more broadly the elevated cost of a useless network of “EU embassies” across the world;
